lines.text: Wisdom calls out at the crossroads and the city gates, telling the simple ones to learn to be shrewd.
Wisdom says to receive her instruction instead of silver, because she is more precious than sapphires.
By wisdom priests reign, and those who seek her early will find her.
Wisdom says God set a boundary for the sea, and she was His delight day by day.
Whoever finds wisdom finds life and the favor of the LORD, but he who fails to find her harms himself.
